Interface AlgoTradingRepository

org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Tenant,Integer>
public interface AlgoTradingRepository extends org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Tenant,Integer>
Tenant serialization and bounded dated market reads for the strategy modules and the replay.

  • Method Details

    • lockTenant

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("SELECT t FROM Tenant t WHERE t.idTenant = ?1") Tenant lockTenant(Integer tenant)

    • findTenant

      @Query("SELECT t FROM Tenant t WHERE t.idTenant = ?1") Tenant findTenant(Integer tenant)
      Reads a tenant without taking a lock, for the callers that only have to establish who owns an environment. A pessimistic lock requires an active transaction, which a read-only request path does not open; using lockTenant(Integer) there fails with No active transaction instead of answering the question.
      Parameters:
      tenant - the tenant to read
      Returns:
      the tenant, or null when no such tenant exists
